title: Full derivative Class-II Gaussian UV power counting and leading contraction
statement: For the canonical full-production quadratic Gaussian on the fixed L=16 three-torus, with three complex components, eta_shell=0, fixed positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers, embedded Pauli generators, the six-real Gaussian convention, and sharp max-norm spectral cutoff N, the point covariance converges while each one-axis derivative covariance satisfies D_N/N -> delta_cube I with delta_cube=I_cube/(6 pi^2 Y L)>0. The exact conditional Wick identities imply that the positive Class-II expected energy grows linearly, E F_II,N / N -> kappa_II>0, and its field-dependent leading contraction is the nonconstant local rational term delta_cube N W_eps(Psi).
scope: T4 bare-Gaussian UV result for the hash-pinned A1 full-production quadratic symbol, fixed torus, fixed positive regularisers, eta_shell=0, sharp cube spectral projector, and derivative J/K Class-II energy. Analytic exponent/coefficient formula plus dual executable calculations; the displayed full-production decimal energy slope is diagnostic rather than an interval enclosure.
falsifier: An incorrect six-real/complex covariance factor, Pauli normalisation, Fourier or per-volume factor; failure of D_N/N to approach the positive cube coefficient; a nonpositive pinned contraction; an out-of-tolerance primary/independent discrepancy; or source-hash drift falsifies the registered result.
no_overclaim: This result does not define the continuum K_A composite, prove finite counterterm closure, prove that subtraction is necessary for every weak limit, classify a possible bare cutoff-concentration limit, construct or rule out a renormalised Class-II Gibbs measure, prove uniform stability/tightness, remove regularisers, take infinite volume, establish a phase transition or BCC state, or justify T5/T6/T7.
